responsibility: Implements construction of the analyzer supergraph, the interprocedural control-flow graph that fuses per-function CFGs with callgraph edges. It assigns stable statement UIDs, splits basic blocks at call sites so calls appear in call and return contexts, creates supernodes and cfg/call/return/intraprocedural edges, preserves and restores original stmt UIDs for LTO safety, supports Graphviz/JSON dumping, and provides callsite-to-callee/caller expression mapping helpers used by interprocedural state transfer.
same_name_distinction: Builds and populates the supergraph declared in supergraph.h: creating supernodes and superedges from CFG/callgraph data, assigning and restoring statement UIDs, and implementing callsite-expression mapping and dumping behavior, while the header mainly defines the graph classes and lookup APIs.
